title: The scikit-learn Estimator API
learning_objectives: Use fit, predict and score on any scikit-learn estimator
Copy an unfitted estimator with clone and read its settings with get_params
Evaluate a regressor with sklearn.metrics (MSE, MAE, R²)
hints: Check `len(X_train) == len(y_train)` and the same for the test arrays.
Metrics take `(y_true, y_pred)`; convert predictions with `[float(v) for v in pred]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Fit on the training data, predict the test rows, and pass (y_true, y_pred) to the metrics.
Use mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error and r2_score on the test set.
Convert results to float and check that X and y lengths match.
